original_finding_content.subject: Trustpilot Pakistani bridal wear seller permanently banned for placeholder image
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Seller of handmade bridal wear from Pakistan reports permanent ban over a single placeholder image mistake that was removed within minutes, despite having production proof.
**Verbatim snippet:** "I invested thousands in my shop LuxoraCrafted (Appeal: 23718763), selling authentic handmade bridal wear from Pakistan. My account was permanently banned over a single placeholder image mistake that I removed in minutes."
**Source:** https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/www.etsy.com
**source_type:** buyer_review
**verification_status:** could_not_verify
**Date:** 2025–2026
**Notes:** Trustpilot review found via Google search snippet (uk.trustpilot.com). Exact review date not confirmed. Pakistan-based. Handmade bridal wear. Appeal number: 23718763. Permanent ban. Degraded to Part 4 due to imprecise date and page-level URL.
